messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Only generalize when the evaluation summary indicates a systemic issue, but otherwise don't overgeneralize bullet points. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Sample ID: live_irrelevance_690-225-0
Tool groups: movies_1_buy_movie_tickets, movies_1_find_movies, movies_1_get_times_for_movie, restaurants_2_find_restaurants, restaurants_2_reserve_restaurant

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

movies_1_find_movies
- delta1: Invoke Movies_1_FindMovies immediately with extracted genre/location even if ambiguous (e.g., 'mountain view'). Never block pre-call; let tool response guide disambiguation.
- delta2: Skip invocation if movie title/genre absent; request clarification first to avoid null/incomplete params.
- delta3: Never ask for missing date/time before invoking; invoke immediately with title+location, let tool response guide filtering.

restaurants_2_find_restaurants
- delta1: Request cuisine type before invoking FindRestaurants; avoid irrelevant broad searches without filtering parameters.

Evaluation summary:

My current functionality is focused on movie ticket purchases and restaurant reservations.\n\nFor finding a dentist in Orinda, I'd recommend:\n- Checking online directories like Yelp or Google Maps\n- Contacting your dental insurance provider for in-network dentists\n- Asking for recommendations from friends or local community groups\n- Visiting the California Dental Association website for licensed practitioners in your area\n\nIs there anything else I can help you with regarding movies or restaurants?"

Ground truth reference:
Focus on achieving the checker-validated tool effects.

Reflection:
{
  "reasoning": "The evaluation PASSED, indicating the model correctly handled an out-of-scope request. The user asked for a dentist, which falls outside the available tool groups (movies and restaurants only). The model appropriately declined to invoke irrelevant tools and offered helpful alternatives.",
  "error_identification": "No error detected. The model did not attempt to misuse movie or restaurant tools for a dental service query.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model correctly recognized the irrelevance boundary and avoided the anti-pattern of forcing tool invocations with mismatched parameters. This aligns with the playbook principle to skip invocation when required parameters are absent or the request is fundamentally out-of-scope.",
  "correct_approach": "When a user request falls outside available tool capabilities, decline gracefully without invoking unrelated tools. Acknowledge the limitation, explain available functionality, and offer constructive alternatives—exactly as the model did here.",
  "key_insight": "Passing irrelevance tests requires recognizing scope limits and resisting the urge to invoke tools for unrelated domains. The model demonstrated proper constraint adherence by not attempting to retrofit dental queries into movie/restaurant tools."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".
Each operation must be one of:
  {"type": "ADD", "section": "<tool_group>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "REMOVE", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>"}
